A '''shock trooper quartermaster''' served in the [[Coruscant Guard]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Republic Military|military branch]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. In [[19 BBY]], following the war's end, the [[quartermaster]] and several other [[Imperial shock trooper|shock troopers]] were stationed on their [[homeworld]] of [[Kamino]] after the activation of [[Order 66]] by [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]. On Kamino, they oversaw numerous situations, such as the transport of a [[Death|deceased]] [[Unidentified Jedi Master (Kamino)|Jedi Master's]] body through a [[Landing bay one-tac-one|hangar bay]] in [[Tipoca City]]. Additionally, after the Republic's [[Proclamation of the New Order|transformation]] into the [[Galactic Empire]], in which the [[officer]] continued their service, the [[trooper]] escorted Imperial [[Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] to Kamino during their planned assessment of the [[Cloning|clone]] [[army]]'s continued production and service to the [[Imperial Army]].

Afterward, the quartermaster encountered the troopers of [[Clone Force 99]], who assumed that they were going to be reprimanded, and instead ordered them to the [[Tipoca City Training Facility]] to be tested in combat proficiency by Tarkin. Not long after their assessment, in which Clone Force 99 refused to [[Mission to Onderon (Clone Force 99)|comply]] with Imperial orders, the officer and their troopers were sent to the Clone Force's quarters to retrieve their gear, where they subsequently arrested the [[Gender|female]] clone [[Omega]] and [[medical droid]] [[AZI-345211896246498721347|AZI-3]]. Once the [[commando]]s returned to Kamino, the quartermaster and a team of other shock troopers assisted Tarkin in arresting the rogue troopers.

==Biography==
===Republic service===
{{Dialogue|Wrecker|Oh, man. What did we miss now?|Quartermaster|The end of the war.|Hunter|Say again, Trooper.|Quartermaster|General Grievous was defeated on Utapau. The Separatist leadership has collapsed. The war is over.|attr=The quartermaster, telling Clone Force 99 the Clone Wars is over|src=<ref name="Aftermath" />}}
[[File:Coruscant_Guards_on_Kamino.png|thumb|right|300px|The quartermaster was a clone shock trooper of the Coruscant Guard (pictured).]]
A [[clone trooper]]<ref name="Aftermath" /> was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] from the genetic material of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]], who served as the [[clone template]] for the [[Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="ClonesData" /> By [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The trooper appears as a [[Imperial shock trooper|shock trooper]] and [[quartermaster]] in "[[Aftermath (episode)|Aftermath]]," which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of to [[19 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Clone Wars]], the [[trooper]] was assigned to the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Coruscant Guard]], in which<ref name="Aftermath" /> they served as both a [[Imperial shock trooper|shock trooper]] and [[quartermaster]]<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1468090554093240321|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=It's only described as 'SHOCK TROOPER QUARTERMASTER' in the script. The other shock troopers in the episode aren't named either.|archivedate=20211207181349}}</ref> for<ref name="Aftermath" /> the [[corps]]<ref name="BC 37">{{BustCollectionCite|37|Character}}</ref> on<ref name="Databank Coruscant Guard">{{Databank|coruscant-guard|Coruscant Guard}}</ref> the planet<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Databank Coruscant Guard" /> In that [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Date" /> after the end of the war with<ref name="Aftermath" /> the [[death]]<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> of Separatist [[Head of State]]<ref name="Front Lines">''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]''</ref> and [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies|Supreme Martial Commander]] [[General]] [[Grievous]],<ref name="Aftermath" /> they and the rest of the clone army received specific orders from [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] to [[Death penalty|execute]] [[Order 66]],<ref name="Order 66">''[[Collapse of the Republic]]'' establishes that every [[clone trooper]], which includes the shock trooper [[quartermaster]], received [[Order 66]] to kill the [[Jedi Order]].</ref> resulting in<ref name="Aftermath" /> [[the galaxy]]-wide [[Great Jedi Purge|termination]]<ref name="Victory">{{TCW|Victory and Death}}</ref> of the [[Jedi Order]].<ref name="Aftermath" />

After the systematic Jedi Purge, hundreds of clone troopers were ordered to return back to their homeworld of Kamino, including the quartermaster and a contingent of shock troopers. Walking among<ref name="Aftermath" /> a [[Unidentified shock trooper squad|squad]]<ref name="AD">{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}} — {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> of troopers in a [[Tipoca City]] [[Landing bay one-tac-one|landing bay]], the [[officer]] encountered the [[Genetically defective clone|genetically defective]] [[clone commando]]s of [[Clone Force 99]], nicknamed the Bad Batch, as they arrived on Kamino aboard<ref name="Aftermath" /> the [[Omicron-class attack shuttle|''Omicron''-class attack shuttle]]<ref name="Cut">{{TBB|Cut and Run}}</ref> [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']], coming from an [[Battle of Kaller|operation]] on the planet [[Kaller]]. With the Bad Batch confused by the Coruscant Guard's presence and the current events after overhearing a [[Level five lockdown|level five containment]] announcement, the quartermaster approached them and explained that Grievous had been killed on<ref name="Aftermath" /> the planet<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> [[Utapau]] and that the Separatist command structure had collapsed, destroying the Confederacy entirely.<ref name="Aftermath" />

[[File:Coruscant-shock-troopers.png|thumb|left|300px|The quartermaster accompanied a detachment of the Coruscant Guard to Kamino by the end of the Clone Wars.]]
Still withholding suspicions for their fellow troopers, the Bad Batch noticed the deceased body of<ref name="Aftermath" /> a [[Unidentified Jedi Master (Kamino)|Jedi Master]]<ref name="Pablo">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1467612968506458115|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=@Grandmaster_Nic The Jedi Master was named in the script; it's a new character, but I'd rather someone more attached the show reveal that information. The other droids only have production names of Kaminoan training droid and Kaminoan medical droid.|archivedate=20211205230643}}</ref> being carried past them. The corpse dropped a [[lightsaber]] on the ground that was immediately picked up by the [[Clone trooper officer|clone officer]], after which the quartermaster stood back up and saw the alarmed faces of the [[commando]]s, to which they asked if there was a problem. Reassuring the officer that there were none, the [[squad]] left for their [[Bad Batch barracks|barracks]] but were advised by the quartermaster to be quick, as a mandatory general assembly on the Republic's state was to be held at 1500 [[Standard hour|hours]]. At the assembly, the entire clone army witnessed<ref name="Aftermath" /> a [[Special session of Congress|special session]] that was proceeding in the [[Galactic Senate]],<ref name="Episode III" /> during which Chancellor Palpatine addressed the so-called Jedi rebellion<ref name="Aftermath" /> to overthrow the Republic<ref name="Episode III" /> and that in order to ensure and continue galactic security and stability, the Republic was being [[Proclamation of the New Order|reorganized]] into the [[Galactic Empire]], appointing himself its [[Galactic Emperor]].<ref name="Aftermath" />

===Imperial service===
{{Dialogue|Quartermaster|Where do you think you're going? The training facility is that way.|Hunter|Training facility?|Quartermaster|For a battle simulation. Admiral Tarkin has requested to see more of your squad in action.|Tech|Then we are not being reprimanded?|Quartermaster|No, you're being tested. Now go gear up.|attr=The quartermaster and Clone Force 99, when the latter deviated from the training facility|src=<ref name="Aftermath" />}}
[[File:Shock-troopers-Kamino-training.png|thumb|right|300px|The quartermaster instructed Clone Force 99 to report to the training facility as ordered by Admiral Wilhuff Tarkin.]]
[[Standard day|Days]] after the Republic's transformation, with the clone troopers now serving<ref name="Aftermath" /> as the Empire's [[stormtrooper]]s,<ref name="Stormtroopers">{{Databank|stormtroopers|Stormtroopers}} establishes that the [[clone trooper]]s went on to serve as [[stormtrooper]]s in the [[Imperial Army]].</ref> the regime began planning to cease the continued production of clones for the [[Imperial Army]], seeking to eventually replace them with a more cost-effective army of conscripted [[soldier]]s. In that time frame, the shock trooper quartermaster had departed from the cloning planet but later returned aboard an Imperial [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class shuttle]], escorting [[Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]], who had come to assess the clone army and speak with [[Kaminoan]] [[Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su]] regarding the former Republic's contracts with the [[Ruling Council (Kamino)|Kaminoan government]]. Desiring a full assessment, Admiral Tarkin summoned the troopers of Clone Force 99, although the squad assumed they were receiving punishment for an earlier brawl in the cafeteria. On their way, the squad passed by the quartermaster through a corridor and were redirected by them to the [[Tipoca City Training Facility|training facility]]. The officer further explained to the confused clones that Tarkin had requested them for a combat proficiency test for his evaluation and told them to get ready.<ref name="Aftermath" />

After they passed the training simulation, an impressed Tarkin presented Clone Force 99 with an [[Mission to Onderon (Clone Force 99)|assignment]] to eliminate a [[Partisans|group]] of insurgents led by [[Saw Gerrera]] located in the [[Japrael sector|Onderon sector]]. Although the targets were labeled as Separatist forces, the commandos refused to follow through with their assignment. Informed of the squad's failure via a [[probe droid]], the quartermaster and a pair of [[Color|white]]-armored clone troopers were ordered to retrieve Clone Force 99's gear from their [[barracks]] and deliver it to the hangar bay. Upon entry, however, the officer and their men encountered the young [[Gender|female]] clone named [[Omega]] and the [[AZ-series surgical assistant droid|AZ-series medical droid]] [[AZI-345211896246498721347|AZI-3]], both of whom had not been authorized to enter the barracks. While their troopers packed the gear, the quartermaster grabbed Omega and attempted to take her away but was briefly stopped by AZI-3, who explained that the Empire had no authority over them due to their affiliation with the Kaminoan government. Frustrated by the [[droid]] touching their [[Limb|arm]], the officer blasted and [[stun]]ned AZI-3, after which the trooper dragged Omega out and brought her to a Kaminoan [[prison]] cell.<ref name="Aftermath" />

[[File:ShockTroopers-BadBatch.png|thumb|left|300px|The quartermaster and several shock troopers confronted the Bad Batch.]]
Planning to arrest Clone Force 99 for failing their mission, the quartermaster and a group of shock troopers situated themselves throughout a hangar bay that the enroute ''Marauder'' and squad would be landing outside of. After the clone commandos entered the hangar, the quartermaster and their fellow troopers revealed themselves from behind the containers in the bay and surrounded the squad. While the Bad Batch was held at gunpoint, Tarkin entered the hangar and asserted that failure and treasonous plotting with Saw Gerrera was not tolerated by the Empire, ordering them to be arrested and held in the brig. Escorted to the prison by the quartermaster and the other troopers, the Bad Batch soon discovered that the holding cell was a retrofitted facility and started planning their escape. The squad then made their escape from both the cell and Kamino with Omega, but not their squadmate [[Crosshair]], who had exhibited loyalty to the Empire.<ref name="Aftermath" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Don't touch me, droid.|The quartermaster to AZI, before stunning the droid|<ref name="Aftermath" />}}
[[File:Shock-trooper-officer-attacks.png|thumb|right|300px|The quartermaster attacked AZI-3 and accosted Omega, both of whom were official Kaminoan personnel.]]
A clone of the [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] Jango Fett, the shock trooper quartermaster was a [[human]] individual who stood at 1.83 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|ft]]) in height,<ref name="ClonesData" /> weighed eighty [[kilogram]]s,<ref name="Weight" /> and had tan skin.<ref name="ClonesData" /> Sternly and frankly spoken, they held both a [[Anti-droid sentiment|dislike]] for droids and little regard for personnel and property not affiliated with the Empire. When the droid AZI-3 attempted to stop them from arresting Omega, as they were Kaminoan government personnel, the officer grew frustrated and angrily called AZI-3 "droid" as opposed to his name before stunning him in response to being touched.<ref name="Aftermath" />

==Skills and abilities==
A military-based officer and quartermaster, they were responsible for a number of duties to both the Republic and Empire. They could also lead and command other clone troopers, including Clone Sergeants and those in and outside of the Coruscant Guard. In addition, the quartermaster also escorted high-ranking officers.<ref name="Aftermath" />

==Equipment==
[[File:Shock-Trooper-officer.png|thumb|left|200px|The quartermaster was equipped with a pauldron in addition to their Phase II clone trooper armor.]]
At birth, like the other clone troopers, the quartermaster was implanted by the Kaminoan [[scientist]]s with a [[behavioral modification biochip]] to ensure that the trooper would not resist certain [[Executive Order Codes for the Grand Army of the Republic|orders]].<ref name="ClonesData" /> The quartermaster wore a set of [[Phase II clone trooper armor]] that<ref name="Aftermath" /> came equipped with an integrated [[comlink]]<ref name="Collapse">''[[Collapse of the Republic]]''</ref> on its right arm<ref name="Aftermath" /> and [[scrambler]] capable of using all Republic communications protocols.<ref name="Collapse" /> The armor, painted with bright red markings to distinguish their service to the Coruscant Guard, was adorned with a red [[pauldron]] on its left shoulder to indicate their position as a military officer.<ref name="Aftermath" />

Also equipped with a [[datapad]], the quartermaster was armed with<ref name="Aftermath" /> a standard-issue<ref name="Rise">''[[Rise of the Separatists]]''</ref> [[DC-15A blaster carbine]] and [[DC-17 repeater hand blaster|DC-17 hand blaster]] kept in a holster on their right thigh. On the back of their utility belt, they were also equipped with a single<ref name="Aftermath" /> [[N-20 Baradium-core thermal detonator]].<ref name="Grenade">"[[Aftermath (episode)|Aftermath]]" depicts the shock trooper quartermaster equipped with what ''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide]]'' identifies as an [[N-20 Baradium-core thermal detonator]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It's only described as 'SHOCK TROOPER QUARTERMASTER' in the script. The other shock troopers in the episode aren't named either.|Lucasfilm Story Group member Pablo Hidalgo, regarding the quartermaster|<ref name="Twitter" />}}
The shock trooper quartermaster first appeared as an unidentified character in "[[Aftermath (episode)|Aftermath]],"<ref name="Aftermath" /> the premier episode of the ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' animated television series' [[The Bad Batch Season 1|first season]], which aired on [[May 4]], [[2021]] on [[Disney+]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-may-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in May 2021|nolive=1}}</ref> Prior to the release of the episode, the quartermaster was revealed in a trailer for the show released on [[March 30]] of that year.<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|BsOmYpP4UDU|Star Wars: The Bad Batch | Official Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/trailer-the-bad-batch}}</ref> Alongside the other clone troopers of both ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch''<ref name="Aftermath" /> and its predecessor, ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'',<ref name="Victory" /> the shock trooper was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="Aftermath" /> According to [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] executive [[Pablo Hidalgo]], the clone trooper was identified in the episode's script as a quartermaster.<ref name="Twitter" />
